hypothesis: Given TWO optional physical diagnostic types and a second action opportunity contingent on the first observed consequence, does fitting the observation family ONLY from disjoint factual training logs beat the best fixed Gaussian, fixed Laplace, and cheapest-first policies by >=0.005 net reward on ALL three fresh unfamiliar DEV cohorts?

sources.latent: fair hidden +/-1, never supplied to fit/policy
sources.physics: cue=theta*visible cue_gain+visible sigma*family noise; paid diagnostic A or B yields theta*visible instrument gain+sigma*family noise ONLY when executed; factual net final reward=theta*actual signed action+reward_sigma*independent family noise-minus actually paid A and B costs
sources.sham: both actual diagnostic gains exactly 0 with positive costs
sources.logging: Random first decision 0/A/B equally; second decision choose a not yet performed probe with p=.5; observed second action may condition on actual first sensor, not hidden theta; final executed sign independent fair; only measured probes observed; all policies fit identical real log.

methods.moment_fit: Fit prior sign, cue/A/B gain and residual variance from actually logged reward proxy, cue and measured probes on first 24576 real fit episodes, no theta.
methods.family_choice: On separate last 4096 FIT logs, choose independently reward/cue/A/B Gaussian-vs-Laplace by integrated hidden-sign marginal likelihood; noise family options supplied by experimenter, not discovered open ended.
methods.candidate: After observed cue, choose best positive net-value probe A/B using fitted family, reveal ONLY chosen measurement, posterior update; decide whether not yet executed probe is worth paying for AFTER first consequence; choose signed final act, collect noisy actual net return.
controls: never buy physical probes, same cue posterior
privileged known-family model-aware reference with true scales and parameters
methods.budget: same two opportunities to execute at most two actual paid diagnostic actions and one final executed action, costs included; all evaluation exogenous tapes identical across arms; no unexecuted signal supplied as feedback
methods.restore: JSON fit stats exact cold decisions and outputs

per_cohort: correct four source family labels reward/cue/A/B
selected net reward >= max(fixed Gaussian, fixed Laplace, cheapest-first)+0.005
>=4% of episodes buy at least one physical probe
>=1% of episodes buy second probe after first actual observation
paired 1000-resample bootstrap lower 95% bound selected vs never >0, seed 870901+OOD_seed
frozen_metrics.sham: zero paid probes on fully uninformative instruments
frozen_metrics.wrong_credit: selected net >= wrong-credit+0.025 in EACH OOD
frozen_metrics.report: reward, real paid A/B counts, second probe count, per-arm realized cost, decision runtime and full source hashes
frozen_metrics.science_boundary: Synthetic DEV only. Does not prove a novel native Hybrid architecture, learning in real physics, equal trained recurrent compute, cold retained transfer or scientific first-use.
